segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, hi, this is Daniel from Northstar Fabrication. We need to add 8 user seats to our account before Monday. Our team lead is onboarding a new estimating group.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can help with that. Can I confirm the workspace name and the billing contact email?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Workspace is Northstar Fab, and billing contact is ap@northstarfab.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I’m in the admin console now. You currently have 42 active seats on the Business plan, billed monthly, next renewal on March 1. Adding 8 seats brings you to 50. The prorated charge through the end of February is $312.40 before tax. Does that look okay to proceed?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that’s fine. And those seats will be available right away, correct?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes. I just applied the seat increase. The new limit is 50, and your admins can invite users immediately. The billing tool will generate the prorated invoice today and email it to ap@northstarfab.com.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Do you have a ticket number for this?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, ticket 184927. I’ll add a note that the 8 seats were added on February 12 with approval from Daniel Reyes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, that’s all I needed. Thanks.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You’re welcome. Have a good one.
